slides.title: The first *30 seconds* decide the other thirty minutes
replace: SUBJECT: a macro crop of a single human EAR with a chrome stud through it, filling the frame, cut by the top and right edges.
COMPOSITION: the ear occupies the right two thirds; the lower-left third stays a quiet flat painted field with nothing on it.
COLOUR: hot magenta replaces the fire-engine red; blue blobs and green scribbles stay.
SUBJECT: a macro crop of an open mouth mid-word, gem-set teeth, wet lips catching the flash.
COMPOSITION: the mouth is pushed to the top-right and cut by both edges; the bottom-left half is a flat blue painted field left empty.
COLOUR: deep orange-red dominant, blue blobs, green scribbles.

slides.title: Nobody stays for the *warm-up*
replace: SUBJECT: a macro crop of an eye squeezed shut behind mirrored wraparound eyewear.
COMPOSITION: the eyewear crosses the upper half diagonally; the lower-left stays a flat quiet field.
COLOUR: electric blue-violet dominant, magenta blobs, green scribbles.
SUBJECT: a macro crop of a gloved hand clamped over a mouth, chrome rings on the fingers.
COMPOSITION: the hand fills the top-right; the bottom-left third is crushed black and empty.
COLOUR: near-black with acid green scribbles and a few blue blobs only.

slides.title: Move your best line to the *top*
replace: SUBJECT: a macro crop of two fingers pinching a thin cable, chrome nails, flash glare on the wire.
COMPOSITION: the fingers enter from the top-right corner; the rest of the frame is a flat painted field.
COLOUR: acid lime yellow-green dominant, ultramarine blobs, magenta scribbles.

slides.title: Start at the *punchline*
replace: SUBJECT: a macro crop of a jaw and throat tipped back, chrome chain across the neck.
COMPOSITION: the throat runs down the right third, cut by the top edge; the left two thirds are a flat field.
COLOUR: hot pink dominant, ultramarine blobs, acid green scribbles.

slides.title: Six tools, *one* pass
replace: SUBJECT: a macro crop of black leather and chrome hardware — buckles, rings and studs filling the frame, no skin.
COMPOSITION: hardware fills the whole frame edge to edge, no single focal point.
COLOUR: near-black leather with a few ultramarine blobs and acid green scribbles only.

slides.title: Your cold open, found for you
replace: SUBJECT: a macro crop of a smile with gem-set teeth, one chrome stud on the lip.
COMPOSITION: the smile sits high and right, cut by the top edge; the bottom half is a flat quiet field.
COLOUR: acid lime yellow-green dominant, blue blobs, magenta scribbles.
